title: App definition
description: A registry entry without clientId, clientSecretRef and release. One file per app under fixtures/apps/. Terraform reads it to create the OAuth client; spactl app add completes it from the infrastructure outputs and applies the registry, so each app is described once. Source: docs/plan/02-contracts.md -> Registry document. Freezes at G1a, except the oauth section, which freezes at G1b. Every shared rule is a $ref into registry.schema.json, so the two cannot drift: a consumer must load both schemas into one registry.

oauth.title: oauth (draft until G1b)

x-freeze.note: The oauth section of an entry is one of the identity parts that wait for G0. Task I-6 folds the G0 findings in and tags contracts-v1.

oauth.description: clientId and clientSecretRef are absent on purpose: Terraform creates the client, and spactl app add adds them. Naming either here is rejected, so a definition can never carry a client id that contradicts the one Terraform made.
